## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is the *Sumati-paripṛcchā* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on the bodhisattva-girl *Sumati* (須摩提, "Good-Mind"). The work has parallel translations: [Kumārajīva's T0335](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0027) and [Bodhiruci's T0336](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0028). The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The doctrinal substance — the Sumati narrative — is one of the principal Mahāyāna sūtras featuring a female bodhisattva-protagonist, and is therefore important for the study of gender in early Mahāyāna literature.

The Taishō text (T0334) is established on the standard apparatus.
